name: dealmaker-extension
description: DealMaker Chrome extension MVP for price detection, comparison, and negotiation insights.

scripts.build: vite build && vite build --config vite.content.config.ts && cp manifest.json dist/ && cp dist/assets/tailwind-*.css dist/content.css 2>/dev/null || true && mv dist/src/panel/index.html dist/panel.html && mv dist/src/options/index.html dist/options.html && rm -rf dist/src
